crossRefs.note: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any…
Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by…
that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

translations.web: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
translations.bsb: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
translations.kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
translations.asv: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.
